ExportResponse.description:
GraphQL-style JSON database returned by /export and /types.

Each top-level key maps to a dict of named GraphQL objects of that type,
reflecting the GraphQL schema defined in unfurl/graphql.py.

ApplicationBlueprint.description: Map of blueprint name → ApplicationBlueprint object
ApplicationBlueprint.title: Applicationblueprint

Deployment.description: Map of deployment name → Deployment object (deployment format only)
Deployment.title: Deployment

DeploymentPath.description: Map of path → DeploymentPath object (registered ensemble paths)
DeploymentPath.title: Deploymentpath

DeploymentTemplate.description: Map of blueprint name → DeploymentTemplate object
DeploymentTemplate.title: Deploymenttemplate

ResourceTemplate.description: Map of template name → ResourceTemplate object (TOSCA node template)
ResourceTemplate.title: Resourcetemplate

ResourceType.description: Map of type name → ResourceType object (TOSCA node type)
ResourceType.title: Resourcetype

ExportResponse.title: ExportResponse

PatchEnsembleBody.description:
JSON body for /create_ensemble, /update_ensemble, and /create_provider.

Extends PatchEnvironmentBody with ensemble-specific fields.

blueprint_url.description: Remote blueprint URL to clone when creating an ensemble
blueprint_url.title: Blueprint Url

cloud_vars_url.description: URL for cloud variables used for vault secret encryption
cloud_vars_url.title: Cloud Vars Url

deployment_blueprint.description: Name of the deployment blueprint to use when creating an ensemble
deployment_blueprint.title: Deployment Blueprint

deployment_path.description: Path for the deployment within the project
deployment_path.title: Deployment Path

latest_commit.description: Latest known commit hash for optimistic concurrency checks
latest_commit.title: Latest Commit

patch.description: List of patch operations describing the changes to apply
patch.title: Patch

private_token.description: Git personal access token or password
private_token.title: Private Token

username.description: Git username for pushing the commit
username.title: Username
